title: Well Smart IFC issue (wsg.issue/1)
description: One issue picked in the 3D viewer or written from a confirmed clash-report line. The cross-release key of a component is model_id + ifc_global_id + db_id; an IFC localId / Express ID is per file and never stored. The anchor is in engineering coordinates of the frozen release; the snapshot is evidence, never the anchor. In pilot mode this JSON is a file under issues/ in the project repository. The example uses <angle-bracket> placeholders that a real record replaces with the full values.

issue_id.description: Server-issued, persistent, stable across releases and review rounds

release_id.description: The frozen release the issue was raised on; the before-view is bound to it

model_id.description: ARCH / STR / MEP … as the DB names the model

sha256.description: Full SHA-256 of the IFC file in that release; a different hash is a different model

ifc_global_id.description: IFC GlobalId (22 characters); what the viewer highlights

db_id.description: Design-database element id (e.g. DUCT-021); what the AI edits

frame_id.description: Engineering frame of the release, e.g. project-engineering-r017

transform_snapshot_id.description: The transform set used to compute xyz from viewer space

viewpoint_ref.description: Camera, clipping planes and visible-component set, restorable in the viewer and exportable to BCF

snapshot_ref.description: Saved image at submission; evidence only

description.description: The one sentence the person typed

history.description: Append-only status changes; CLOSED needs verified evidence on the new release, never the designer's reply alone

note.description: What was verified or changed; closure evidence goes here

release_id.description: The release the status refers to (after-release for READY_FOR_REVIEW / CLOSED)

examples.description: DEMO: duct clashes with beam; prefer east reroute and retain corridor clear height.
